title: Insurer Recoupment Reserve on Reporting-Floor Pay-Downs (Placed Consumer Accounts)
content:
Cashiering standard clause for **Placed Consumer Accounts** on the insurer recoupment reserve that applies to the reporting-floor pay-down after a recent insurance payment credit.

## Clause

The insurer recoupment reserve is **$40.00** where an insurance payment credit was booked on the account in the last three months and an insurance denial rebill was added in the last six months; **$20.00** where an insurance payment credit was booked in the last three months and no insurance denial rebill was added in the last six months; and **nothing** where no insurance payment credit was booked in the last three months.

The reserve is added, at its full amount, in working out the reporting-floor pay-down.

## Elements

| Element | Read from |
|---|---|
| Insurance payment credit | A client credit on the account's money history with reason insurance payment, by the date it was booked |
| Insurance denial rebill | A supplemental addition on the account's money history with reason insurance denial rebill, by the date it was added |
| Last three months, last six months | Fewer than three (or six) whole calendar months between the entry's date and the handling date, a whole month being reached on the same day of a later month |

## Condition table

| Insurance payment credit in the last three months | Insurance denial rebill in the last six months | Reserve |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | $40.00 |
| Yes | No | $20.00 |
| No | either | nothing |

## Hypothetical cases

*Invented medical accounts, handling date 2026-10-10.*

- Insurance payment credit booked 2026-08-14; insurance denial rebill added 2026-05-20. Reserve $40.00.
- Insurance payment credit booked 2026-07-11; no rebill since 2025. Reserve $20.00.
- Insurance payment credit booked 2026-07-10 (three whole months back); rebill added 2026-09-01. Reserve nothing.
